# Open Compute

> Developer documentation for open-compute: the declared Workers programming model on one machine. No global edge, billing, or Cloudflare dashboard.

Origin: https://open-compute.dev

Each product below is a top-level docs URL. Compatibility and live limits come from `ocd capabilities --json` on the running binary.

## Start

- [Overview](https://open-compute.dev/): One-machine Workers platform
- [Get started](https://open-compute.dev/get-started): Hello Worker on a ready ocd
- [Directory](https://open-compute.dev/directory): Supported products and status
